question: According to the 2011 census, Daman and Diu has the lowest sex ratio among all union territories of India with only ______ females per 1000 males.
solution:
The correct answer is __**618**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India's Sex ratio is 943 as per the census 2011.
 
• The sex ratio was 933 as per the 2001 population.
 
• Daman & Diu has the lowest sex ratio (618).</l
